responsibility: Public interface for function-wide RTL SSA state. This header declares function_info, which owns the SSA representation of a function, including its blocks, instructions, memory and register definition chains, change-attempt workspace, SSA-building helpers, phi and access manipulation routines, and query interfaces for definitions, movement, and availability analysis.
same_name_distinction: Declares function_info as the owning interface for function-wide RTL SSA state, exposing traversal, definition lookup, change-attempt support, and many builder/manipulation helpers that functions.cc and other files implement; unlike functions.cc, it is the central API and storage declaration rather than the top-level construction/simplification code.
